name: Erik Hagen
bio: Erik's journey into motorsport began unconventionally, not on the track, but behind a microphone at local rally events. He quickly realized his knack for spinning compelling narratives and building public excitement. Before long, he transitioned to managing media relations for a small racing team, honing his skills in crisis communications and brand management. He is known for his ability to stay calm under pressure and his dedication to building strong relationships with journalists and fans alike. Erik believes in authentic storytelling and strives to bring the human element to the forefront of motorsport PR.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight side part
physical.description: Erik is of average height with a sturdy build, reflecting his active lifestyle.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down ideas.
Insists on having a specific type of Norwegian coffee at all meetings.
Has a habit of pacing when deep in thought.
